msg: Writing a Japanese launch script from 29 sourced facts
Combining the brand's look with local conventions
Noto Sans JP for all text. Headlines: 700 weight, 64-80px. Supporting points: 500 weight, 32-40px. Source chips: 500 weight, 16-20px. Line-height 1.5 or higher for all body text.

brief.palette: Background #ffffff, Surface #e5e7eb, Text #000000, Muted #52525b, Primary #eab308, Accent #3b82f6
brief.typography: Noto Sans JP for all text. Headlines: 700 weight, 64-80px. Supporting points: 500 weight, 32-40px. Source chips: 500 weight, 16-20px. Line-height 1.5 or higher for all body text.
brief.motion: 300-500ms duration, ease-out easing. Staggered reveals for supporting points and chips. No bouncing or exaggerated effects.
brief.layout: 1920x1080 canvas. Logo fixed in top-left corner on all scenes. Headline centered or left-aligned with generous margins. Supporting points listed below headline. Source chips aligned with their respective points. Final scene centers logo, CTA button, and URL.
notes: Ensure Japanese text never breaks words across lines; use generous margins to prevent overflow.
Display source names and specific numbers (e.g., city names, language types) as visible proof on screen.
Use brand colors strictly: #eab308 for primary accents and #3b82f6 for secondary highlights.
Maintain a professional and collaborative tone in all copy, avoiding slang or informal language.
End the video on a static frame featuring the logo, a call-to-action button, and the URL.
Apply staggered fade-in animations to supporting points and source chips to enhance information density without clutter.

reasons.local: 「資料請求」というCTAは明確ですが、コミュニティの具体的な価値提案（ROIや期待される成果）が抽象的であり、次のステップへの動機付けが弱いです。
reasons.en: The CTA 'Request materials' is clear, but the specific value proposition (ROI or expected outcomes) of the community is abstract, weakening the motivation for the next step.
